scenes.title: 1 · Tree onboarding and consent
scenes.narration: A tree is registered with a coarse geohash only. Camera collection needs its own consent — the demo refuses to continue without it.

scenes.title: 2 · Privacy polygon and mask boundary
scenes.narration: Drag a vertex of the tree ROI, then widen the neighbour mask. Every change resets both approvals, and detections that fall mostly outside the allowed region are dropped.

scenes.title: 3 · Open-Meteo ripening curve
scenes.narration: Warm the weather offset and the growing-degree-day curve advances, moving the stage and the harvest window. The projection stays experimental, with human review required.

scenes.title: 4 · Volunteer dispatch
scenes.narration: Confirm readiness, assign two volunteers, and dispatch. The result shows per-recipient outcomes, masked phone numbers, and body digests — never message bodies.
